title: RQ Keuangan
description: App catatan kas Rumah Quran — saldo, pemasukan, dan pengeluaran dengan foto bukti. Pengunjung hanya bisa melihat (termasuk bukti), pengelola masuk dengan token untuk mengelola.
long_description:
RQ KEUANGAN — CATATAN KAS RUMAH QURAN
• Aplikasi pencatatan kas untuk Rumah Quran: saldo kas, pemasukan, dan pengeluaran dengan kategori
• Lampiran foto bukti transaksi, diunggah otomatis ke Vercel Blob sebagai thumbnail WebP
• Mode pengunjung (baca-saja): bisa melihat data dan foto bukti, tanpa tombol mengubah
• Mode pengelola: masuk dengan token untuk menambah, mengubah, dan menghapus catatan

GRAFIK & ANALISIS
• Dashboard ringkasan saldo dan perbandingan pemasukan vs pengeluaran
• Grafik arus kas per bulan dan komposisi kategori
• Pencarian, filter, dan paginasi daftar transaksi

TEKNIS
• React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS
• API serverless di Vercel, database Neon (PostgreSQL), foto di Vercel Blob Storage
• Autentikasi berbasis token (SHA-256) dengan dua tingkat akses: lihat saja vs kelola

title: TOPAS MC - Carbon Ion 330 MeV
description: Monte Carlo microdosimetry analysis of a mono-energetic 330 MeV/u carbon ion beam for predicting RBE of carbon ion therapy. Full paper ready.
long_description:
TOPAS MC — CARBON ION 330 MEV
• Monte Carlo simulation of a mono-energetic 330 MeV/u carbon ion beam in a water phantom
• Built with TOPAS v3.9 on the Geant4 toolkit

TECH APPROACH
• TOPAS microdosimetric extension + 3D SOI Bridge microdosimeter (59×72 silicon SVs, 30×30×10 µm³) for micron-scale energy deposition
• Mono-energetic beam (12C6+, 3960 MeV / 330 MeV/u, spread 0.1%) — no SOBP, isolates the microdosimetry-to-RBE link
• Physics lists: g4em-standard_opt4, QGSP_BIC_HP, binary cascade (validated for heavy-ion transport)
• Histories: 10⁵ plateau / 10⁶ Bragg / 10⁷ tail for statistical accuracy
• Scored frequency- & dose-mean lineal energy (yF̄, yD̄) from microdosimetric spectra

RBE MODEL
• Modified Microdosimetric Kinetic Model (mMKM) converts yD̄ → RBE10
• HSG cell params: α₀ = 0.13 Gy⁻¹, β = 0.05 Gy⁻², rd = 0.42 µm; reference 200 kVp X-rays (αX = 0.19, βX = 0.05)

RESULTS (RINGKAS)
• Bragg peak at 201.0 mm vs experiment 198.19 mm → ~2.8 mm range difference
• yD̄ rises toward Bragg peak, max ≈ 272 keV/µm at 202 mm
• RBE10: ≈ 1.17 at entrance → max 3.02 ± 0.38 at 201 mm → gradual decrease beyond
• Elevated RBE past peak driven by secondary nuclear fragments

long_description:

• SQLite / MySQL, Laravel Pail (real-time logs)
• PHPUnit 12, Laravel Pint (code style)

title: 194 MeV/u Carbon Ion RBE
description: Analysis of the Relative Biological Effectiveness of 194 MeV/u monoenergetic carbon-ion therapy using TOPAS-based Monte Carlo simulation and an SOI microdosimeter.
long_description:
TOPAS MC - 194 MeV/u CARBON ION RBE
Analysis of Relative Biological Effectiveness (RBE10) in 194 MeV/u monoenergetic carbon-ion therapy using TOPAS-based Monte Carlo simulation.

TECH APPROACH
• TOPAS 3.9 (Geant4) simulation of a 194 MeV/u monoenergetic 12C beam in a PMMA phantom
• Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI) microdosimeter for micrometer-scale lineal energy spectra
• Comparison with a Tissue-Equivalent Proportional Counter (TEPC) microdosimeter from a previous study
• Gaussian beam position distribution (sigma = 11 mm) using pencil beam scanning
• 1 um step resolution with TsYScorer for yF, yD, and RBE estimation using the MK Model

RBE MODEL
• Modified Microdosimetric Kinetic Model (mMKM) for converting dose-mean lineal energy (yD) to RBE10
• Photon reference radiation and LQ parameters linked to Monte Carlo microdosimetric spectra

RESULTS (SUMMARY)
• RBE10 increased from 1.40 at the entrance to 2.91 at the Bragg peak (70 mm), then decreased to 1.15 in the distal tail
• yD peaked at 234.36 keV/um at 70 mm and decreased to 11.65 keV/um at 153 mm
• Simulated Bragg peak at 70 mm versus 65 mm experimentally, showing a 5 mm shift while remaining consistent
• SOI provided high spatial resolution and more stable RBE10 estimation compared with TEPC
